title: Kaleidoscope Lab
objectives: Use the rule (360 ÷ angle) − 1 to count images
Explain how a periscope sees over walls
Explain how a kaleidoscope makes patterns

stages.title: The Hall of Clones
stages.narration: Umbra has cloned himself with mirrors. Count the images to find the real villain!

steps.text: Dozens of Umbras appear in a hall of angled mirrors.
Shard 5 is held by the REAL one.
Ray Bot: 'Count the images to expose him!'

stages.title: How Many Images?
stages.prompt: Use (360 ÷ angle) − 1 to pick the number of images for each mirror angle.

tasks.label: Mirrors parallel (0°), facing each other
tasks.explain: Parallel facing mirrors give an infinite tunnel of images.

stages.title: Inside the Light Tools
stages.prompt: Tap each tool to learn how it uses mirrors. Visit them all!

locations.label: Periscope
locations.info: Two mirrors at 45° carry light down a tube so you can see over a wall or above water.

locations.label: Kaleidoscope
locations.info: Angled mirror strips reflect coloured beads many times, making symmetrical repeating patterns.

locations.label: Submarine
locations.info: A submarine's periscope lets the hidden crew see above the sea's surface.

locations.label: Barber Shop
locations.info: Two parallel facing mirrors create an endless tunnel of your reflection.

stages.title: Mini-Boss: Expose the Real Umbra
stages.prompt: Score 80% to count past the clones and grab shard 5!

questions.q: Two mirrors at 60° form how many images?
As the mirror angle gets smaller, the number of images…
questions.explain: Smaller angle = more reflections = more images.
Two 45° mirrors reflect light around the bend of the tube.
Angled mirrors multiply the beads into repeating symmetrical patterns.
Light bounces back and forth endlessly, making infinite images.

stages.title: Crystal Shard 5 Recovered!
messages: 🏅 You earned the Prism Pathfinder badge
You counted the clones and unmasked the real Umbra!
